name: Company user logs in through the real sign-in form
fullName: ../.features-gen/e2e-tests/bdd/features/login.feature.spec.js › User Login › Company user logs in through the real sign-in form

steps.name: Given real COMPANY credentials are available
When the COMPANY user signs in through the sign-in form
Then the token exchange should return 200
And the browser should hold the session cookie pair

session cookie must be set (have: consent_cat_MARKETING, consent_cat_MARKETING_sig, consent_cat_ANALYTICS, consent_cat_ANALYTICS_sig, consent_cookie_policy, consent_cookie_policy_sig, session, session_sig)
And the authenticated user should have role "COMPANY"
